secondAccount.heading: This created a second account
secondAccount.body: You already had an account here with this email address, opened with {{existing}}. Signing in with {{new}} has made a new, separate one — your tables and settings are on the {{existing}} account, and this one starts empty.
secondAccount.why: That is on purpose: two sign-in services reporting the same address are not proof of the same person, so we never join accounts by email.
secondAccount.step4: That is all: the two become one account, keeping everything from both, and either {{existing}} or {{new}} opens it from then on.

merged.heading: Your accounts are now one
merged.body: {{existing}} and {{new}} both open this account from now on. Nothing was lost: everything that was on either of them is here.
merged.noTables: There were no tables to bring across.
